title: Infernux v0.4.0 · Multiplatform Builds and Distribution
summary: 0.4.0 adds Windows, Linux, Android, and Web Player builds, expands InxPackage authoring and runtime asset delivery, and puts shared build environments under Hub management.

items.title: Build Windows and Linux Editors and Players, Android APK/AAB packages, and Web Players from the shared build service.
items.text: Build Windows and Linux Editors and Players, Android APK/AAB packages, and Web Players from the shared build service.

items.title: Deliver precompiled Players, runtimes, and target tools in the four platform plugins; normal exports require no engine checkout, submodules, CMake, or native engine compilation.
items.text: Deliver precompiled Players, runtimes, and target tools in the four platform plugins; normal exports require no engine checkout, submodules, CMake, or native engine compilation.

items.text: Run native targets on Vulkan and browser targets on WebGPU, including Python gameplay, rendering, input, UI, audio, and particles.
